summary.name: Hoppscotch Desktop App
summary.one_liner: Hoppscotch Desktop App is the native download of the Hoppscotch API development client for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
use_cases: build and test APIs natively on the desktop
install API testing client on macOS, Windows, or Linux
use a portable API client on Windows without installing
choose the correct installer for Apple Silicon or Intel Mac
summary.what_it_does: The page is a download and installation guide for the Hoppscotch Desktop App. It offers builds for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs (.dmg), Windows (64-bit .msi installer and portable .exe), and Linux (.deb and .AppImage). It explains the desktop version numbering scheme, where the desktop major is the last two digits of the release year (for example, 26.6.0 corresponds to the 2026.6.0 release). It also gives basic install steps: download, open the file, follow the installer, then open the app and click "Open" if a warning appears.
notable: Separate builds for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs
Windows portable .exe alongside the MSI installer
Linux distributed as both .deb and AppImage
Desktop version numbers use a shortened year form (26.x.x for 2026.x.x)
caveats: Windows MSI major version cannot exceed 255, so the version number is shortened
